name: create-fiction-skills
description: 网文与竖屏短剧写作 skills：从创意到网文、分集剧本、分镜和图片 / 视频提示词。Agent Skills for Chinese web novels and vertical short dramas, from idea to novel, episode script, storyboard and image / video prompts.

plugins.name: create-fiction
plugins.description: 核心 10 个 skill：建书、策划、写章、审校、设定一致性、技法、总入口、短剧改编、分镜、视觉提示词。Core skills: project setup, planning, chapters, review, continuity, craft, workflow, short drama, storyboard, visual prompts.

plugins.name: create-fiction-extras
plugins.description: 可选：长篇故事索引（node:sqlite）与实验性的平台定时发布。Optional: story index for long books and experimental scheduled publishing.
